page_title: HAV 3-1 NIC | Le Havre v Nice 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' 3 - 1 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Tom Louchet (Nice), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 3:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
84' Luka Elsner prepares a substitution. Mohamed Bayo is replaced by Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre).
84' Here comes a substitution. Yassine Kechta is given a rest as he is replaced by Andre Ayew (Le Havre).
82' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) reacts stupidly and the referee shows him a deserved red card!
82' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) receives a red card due to his mindless behaviour. His team will now have to play with a man down.
80' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremie Pignard had an easy-decision to make.
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Dante (Nice) was quite harsh and Jeremie Pignard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
76' Nice are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
74' Aliou Balde (Nice) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Tom Louchet comes onto the pitch to replace him.
74' Here is a change. Josue Casimir is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre).
72' Aliou Balde (Nice) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
72' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hicham Boudaoui.
71' Loic Nego (Le Havre) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
71' Loic Nego (Le Havre) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
70' The corner is swung in but Nice can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
70' Aliou Balde (Nice) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
68' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
66' That will be all from Emmanuel Sabbi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
65' Oussama Targhalline comes off the pitch to be replaced by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre).
62' Jeremie Pignard shows a yellow card to Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) for his blatant foul.
61' Francesco Farioli decides to make a substitution. Evann Guessand will be replaced by Aliou Balde (Nice).
61' Substitution. Romain Perraud (Nice) on for Melvin Bard.
60' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle and signals a foul after Etienne Youte Kinkoue (Le Havre) brought his opponent down.
59' A pass from Morgan Sanson (Nice) is intercepted by Arthur Desmas and the move breaks down.
56' Melvin Bard (Nice) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
54' Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle. Josue Casimir (Le Havre) commits a foul after dangerous play.
54' 36:64 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
51' 3 - 0 Goal! Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) puts the ball into the middle of the goal past the outstretched arm of Marcin Bulka.
51' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
49' Melvin Bard (Nice) brings an opponent down and Jeremie Pignard interrupts the game. Le Havre are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
49' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Le Havre is cautioned for aggressive play.
46' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Morgan Sanson comes on the pitch for Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Arthur Desmas (Le Havre) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+2' Arthur Desmas (Le Havre) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
44' Jeremie Pignard interrupts the game. One of the players from Le Havre won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
43' The resulting corner from Jeremie Boga (Nice) is cleared.
43' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Gaetan Laborde (Nice). Nice force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
40' The corner from Jeremie Boga (Nice) is cleared away by the defence.

40' Loic Nego (Le Havre) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jeremie Pignard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
40' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
35' 2 - 0 Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) converts a killer cross before stroking a beautiful finish into the top right corner.
33' Now Le Havre have a corner.
31' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
30' Jeremie Boga (Nice) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Arthur Desmas.
28' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
27' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
27' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
22' Dante (Nice) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jeremie Pignard saw the whole situation.
20' The ball is out of play. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner.
19' The ball goes behind for a corner. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
17' Jeremie Pignard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Josue Casimir (Le Havre) and blew his whistle.
15' Corner kick. Le Havre will have an opportunity.
13' The Nice players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
12' Nice failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Evann Guessand (Nice) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
9' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nice.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
5' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
3' Nice control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
2' Dangerous play by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice). Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Nice will kick-off.
